investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC only: a plain curl GET of the venue's own official events page revealed a Nuxt SPA whose retained window.__NUXT__.config exposes its own public headless-CMS admin URL ('wagtailURL':'https://admin.festsaal-kreuzberg.de'). Wagtail's own standard, public, unauthenticated API v2 (no token) was then queried directly with plain curl GETs — first the page-tree root to confirm real registered page types, then filtered by type=home.EventPage, then individual event detail_urls — all read-only, no browser, no per-page HTML crawling of the Nuxt frontend needed at all.

probe_history.reason: The venue's own official events page (https://festsaal-kreuzberg.de/en/events/) is a Nuxt SPA; its retained, server-sent window.__NUXT__.config block (no JS execution needed to read it) directly states its own headless CMS admin URL, 'https://admin.festsaal-kreuzberg.de'. A plain, unauthenticated GET against that admin host's own public Wagtail API v2 root (https://admin.festsaal-kreuzberg.de/api/v2/pages/) returned 200 with a real page tree (648 total pages) that itself named a 'home.EventPage' type; filtering by that type and fetching individual event detail_urls returned real, structured event records (title/date/doors/start/ticket/price/location) directly. This directly answers the investigation question at Level 1 — no structural/browser escalation was needed.

venue_reference: Festsaal Kreuzberg (concert venue, Kreuzberg, Berlin — Am Flutgraben 2, 12435 Berlin)

identity.notes: The venue's own dedicated first-party domain (festsaal-kreuzberg.de) self-identifies directly: its retained <title> is 'Festsaal Kreuzberg - Programm', and its own retained window.__NUXT__.config states 'site':{'title':'Festsaal Kreuzberg','description':'Erlebe die angesagtesten Konzerte und Veranstaltungen in Berlin Kreuzberg...'}. The headless CMS admin host it points to, admin.festsaal-kreuzberg.de, shares the identical domain and brand, and its own public page tree confirms a 'home.HomePage' whose html_url is the same festsaal-kreuzberg.de domain.

site_classification.platform: Wagtail CMS (Django-based headless CMS), queried via its own standard, public, unauthenticated API v2 (not the site's rendered Nuxt frontend) at admin.festsaal-kreuzberg.de/api/v2/. A real, confirmed page type 'home.EventPage' exists in this CMS's own page tree.

title.notes: Each event page's own 'title' field, stated directly.

start_date.notes: Each event page's own 'date' field, an explicit 'YYYY-MM-DD' string stated directly — no combination/inference needed.

time.notes: Each event page's own 'start' field, a local 'HH:MM:SS' string stated directly, with NO UTC offset/timezone anywhere on the record — honestly a floating local time (presumed Europe/Berlin), never upgraded to UTC. A separate 'doors' field (also floating-local) gives admission time, distinct from 'start'.

end.notes: No end time or end date field exists on any sampled event record.

venue_location.notes: IMPORTANT, deliberately NOT promoted to PROVEN: this API is NOT scoped to only Festsaal Kreuzberg itself. Each event page's own 'location' field is a nullable reference to a 'home.VenueLocationPage'; when populated (e.g. event 844 'Popkultur Festival 2026': location.title 'Festsaal'; event 779 'Oidorno': location.title 'Festsaal'; event 872: location.title 'Biergarten') it resolves to one of only 12 confirmed VenueLocationPage entries, all of which are genuinely internal sub-locations of the Festsaal Kreuzberg complex itself (Festsaal, Kaminzimmer, Ostflügel, Biergarten, Gewächshaus, Eventlocation, Gelände — retained in ev-venue-locations), analogous to Razzmatazz's numbered rooms. BUT at least one sampled record (event 702, 'Moka Efti Orchestra') has 'location': null AND its own 'ticket' field is a URL literally containing 'freilichtbuehne-weissensee-berlin' — direct, retained evidence that this specific event is genuinely hosted at a DIFFERENT venue entirely (Freilichtbühne Weißensee), not Festsaal Kreuzberg, even though it appears in this same site's own EventPage list. Defaulting every null-location record to 'Festsaal Kreuzberg' would therefore fabricate a wrong venue identity for at least this record — exactly what docs/SOURCE_INVESTIGATION_POLICY.md prohibits. venue_location is honestly PROVEN only per-record when 'location' is populated and resolves to a known Festsaal-complex sub-location; it must stay UNKNOWN per-record when 'location' is null, never defaulted.

source_record_id.notes: Each event page's own Wagtail 'id' field — Wagtail (Django) page primary keys are permanent, platform-native identifiers by the CMS's own well-documented design (auto-incrementing, never reassigned), the same class of platform-native stable-identifier reasoning already accepted for razzmatazz-barcelona-01's Sanity '_id', kesselhaus-kulturbrauerei-berlin-01's Firebase push id, and heimathafen-neukoelln-berlin-01's WordPress post id.

event_url.notes: Each event page's own 'url' field is only a site-relative path ('/de/programm/popkultur-festsaal26/'), not an absolute URL — this candidate's own confirmed official_url ('https://festsaal-kreuzberg.de') and that relative path are two retained pieces of context, mechanically concatenated. Live-verified to resolve (HTTP 200) for two sampled records (event 844 and event 779's English variant).

derivation.rule: Concatenate this candidate's own confirmed official_url root ('https://festsaal-kreuzberg.de', with no trailing slash) with the event page's own 'url' field (a site-relative path beginning with '/'), yielding the public front-end event URL. Live HTTP 200 was independently confirmed for the concatenated result on two sampled records.

price.notes: Present as a raw German-decimal-comma numeric string on some records (event 702 'Moka Efti Orchestra': 'price':'51,80', no currency symbol/code in the field itself) but 'null' on others (event 844 'Popkultur Festival 2026', which instead states free admission only via its own separate 'sub_title' text field, 'Free Entry') — genuinely inconsistent per record, honestly not promoted to a single reliable value.

blockers.description: This EventPage API is not scoped to Festsaal Kreuzberg alone — at least one sampled record ('Moka Efti Orchestra', id 702) is genuinely hosted at a different venue (Freilichtbühne Weißensee per its own ticket URL) with 'location': null. Any future collector for this source MUST NOT default an unresolved 'location' to 'Festsaal Kreuzberg' — it needs either an explicit allow-list of the 7 confirmed Festsaal-complex VenueLocationPage titles (Festsaal/Kaminzimmer/Ostflügel/Biergarten/Gewächshaus/Eventlocation/Gelände) with everything else excluded or routed to HUMAN_REVIEW, or a separate venue-resolution step this investigation does not attempt to solve.

Only 5 EventPage records and 12 VenueLocationPage records were sampled; the null-location/cross-venue pattern was demonstrated on one concrete example, not exhaustively characterised across the full 81-record EventPage set.
